Program: Deliver a governed and recoverable institutional repository beta
Vision: docs/vision.md
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Immediate milestone: docs/local-demo-plan.md

Outcome: Meet the lab/project repository promise within an explicitly accepted institutional scope.
Completion: All seven required epics and all conditional epics activated by SITE01.3 pass with retained, source-bound evidence. EP0 first proves the local installation and guided demonstration. Q03.3 later records a named institutional pilot go/no-go. No production source cutover follows from either milestone.

Required epics:
- EP0: bd-01M4X5M9TGQV4QYWRASHCZQV0V
- EP1: bd-01M4W5P2G3FCFHYJ3J9VNBPCRM
- EP2: bd-01M4W5P2KP3KB4M3C8PS3CYAGZ
- EP3: bd-01M4W5P2RA31CS3MZVC1K2GBXS
- EP4: bd-01M4W5P2YQVKVP7ERG6ZGEZD5C
- EP5: bd-01M4W5P33FES8TED58TNGTA873
- EP6: bd-01M4W5P3AZ1X514RZY328NKP66

Scope: seven required plus two conditional epics, 19 gates and 71 tasks. First qualify the local installation and guided demo (EP0/L01), then seek institutional approval through explicitly authorized discussions. Native-staging engineering uses L01.1; SITE01.3 later adds any institution-required transport or integration gaps. No institutional approval exists yet.

Conditional EP7/EP8 require explicit SITE01.3 activation and must then block both this program and Q03.3; deferred does not mean implemented. Required human/provider/operator evidence cannot be inferred from local synthetic fixtures. Production source cutover remains a separate decision.

Progress: F01.1-F01.3 and the F01 design gate are closed; O01.1 service artifact is closed with 679-test and packaged runtime evidence. See per-task receipts under docs/evidence/institutional-pilot. Current source and task references are authoritative in docs/institutional-readiness-backlog.json.
